registration: Frontage on the shared London Street line x=7.5 used by NatWest and the east-side placeholders; local u runs south from NatWest's corrected return end (y=-42.66, 0.02m clearance). Google's place pin for 15 London St (53.6484152,-3.0037463) falls at site x=10.0, y=-46.4, inside this footprint. Old placeholder outline -42.68 to -53.1 (10.42m) now holds the 9.10m building and a 1.32m alley; William Hill's placeholder edge (-53.1) is unchanged.
measurement: Widths and heights are visually calibrated from the near-frontal May2011 Street View (pano XibO1wwSLghj_p6Oqn5oNw, heading 40), scaled so building plus alley equal the mapped 10.42m outline (about 0.0215m per screen pixel); proportions cross-checked in the Nov2020 oblique and the snag photograph. Satellite scale bar (22.8px/m) gives about 9.9m from NatWest to the alley at roof level and an alley/eave gap of 0.7-0.9m above a wider ground-level gap. Nothing here is surveyed.
detail_review: Oct23 detail pass against the May2011 frontal and Nov2020 close views: north bay 1.45m, its first floor in the main jetty plane with a curved brace falling from the top left to the post; left oriel window three lights, a single leaded light opening the canted centre, right window four lights; the street gable is centred on the whole frontage (apex 4.7m from NatWest in the May2011 frontal view; ridge meets the street 4.75m from NatWest in satellite), so its north bargeboard runs down over the bay to the NatWest wall; the bay attic light and hipped roof (eaves about 7.3m, top 8.4m) sit set back behind it; gable rise about 0.63 of its half-span, apex about 9.8m; gable framed by twin centre posts with small chevrons between them and four parallel braces each side rising outward to the bargeboards (no queen posts); chimney on the ridge further back, hidden behind the gable apex in the frontal view.
estimated: Range depth 10m (placeholder outline), rear range 4.2m high, roof pitch about 44 degrees, oriel projections 0.40/0.65m, bay roof form, chimney position, alley rear closure at x=30.4 and all hidden side/rear elevations.
